quality_risks.english_bridge: CRITICAL RISK — Parallel pair is Mundari-English, NOT Hindi-Mundari. Converting to Hindi would require English->Hindi machine translation bridging, which introduces severe semantic drift.
quality_risks.domain_mismatch: HIGH — Specialized culinary recipes (wild edible tubers, indigenous leafy vegetables, traditional fermentation, cooking implements) with near-zero overlap with Class 1-3 FLN literacy and numeracy.

resources.nmt_usefulness_rationale: Direct verification confirms exactly 50 recipes and 783 sentence pairs under CC-BY-4.0. However: (1) it is Mundari-English with 0 Hindi text; (2) using it for Hindi->Mundari would require synthetic English->Hindi back-translation, violating data-integrity rules; (3) the domain is indigenous culinary recipes with near-zero relevance to primary FLN classroom instructions; (4) files are currently gated on Hugging Face.
resources.recommended_next_action: Retain metadata manifest in data/quarantine/karya_endangered_recipes_500/. Do NOT ingest into training. If authenticated access is granted in future phases, could be evaluated as an English-Mundari cultural reference corpus.

resources.recommended_next_action: Stage in data/incoming/asjp_mundari/ as gold-standard Swadesh lexical benchmark for pronunciation and root verification. Do NOT convert into artificial sentence pairs.
